description: This file defines the `EntityUniqueProperty` class, which implements a validation rule to check the uniqueness of a property value across entities in the database. It is part of the OrangeHRM system's API validation rules.

classes.name: EntityUniqueProperty
classes.description: A validation rule class to ensure that a specified property value is unique within an entity, supporting options for trimming and matching or ignoring specific values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityUniqueProperty with entity name, property, and optional matching or ignoring options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to check if the input value is unique based on the configured criteria.
